# Comfy VEED Clean Audio- Speech Cleanup

Remove background noise from a speech recording with VEED Clean Audio: music and effects go with the noise, pauses are cleaned completely, and the voice comes back as 48 kHz mono audio, optionally normalized to a target loudness. Audio up to 1799 seconds. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_veed_clean_audio.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
